summary: AlembicPlugin P2 completed. Commit 7afd28c1f40d25216ecfeffb2160e1b407eca541 implements stateless single-stage alembic_plan confirm -> planSelection. confirm now reads no draft, writes no plan row, no longer builds plan/projectContextCreationGuide/planId/version/signature output, requires generationStage and projectProfile from the Agent payload, validates selectedDimensions/scale/moduleBindings/plannedNextActions/evidenceRefs/rationale through the single-stage Core PlanIntent validator, and returns only status confirmed plus planSelection and nextActions. PlanInput schema removes legacy confirm identity fields and multi-stage residue: basePlanId, planId, baseVersion, version, projectContextSignature, per-dimension stage, scale budgetLevel/scale/perStage. Added targeted unit coverage for incomplete payload errors, complete flat planSelection output, no ProjectContext collection via hoisted mock, strict input-schema legacy rejection, and clean-output legacy-key rejection. P3 executor planSelection gate/job forwarding, P4 checkpoint/SOP derivation, and P5 broad test rewrite/e2e were intentionally left untouched.
